basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old aspiring musician from Ann Arbor, Michigan, trying to learn the ropes of music production in my spare time. I work as a freelance graphic designer and often find inspiration in the local indie music scene. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekend mornings. I enjoy engaging with communities that share my love for gaming and music, and I'm always on the lookout for new tips and tricks to improve my craft. I’m in a long-term relationship with my partner, and we both share a passion for technology and creative arts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of audio equipment and music production, mainly self-taught through online tutorials and trial-and-error with various digital audio workstations. My knowledge is also supplemented by discussions on music forums and feedback from fellow musicians.
